perks.name: MIDA Software Package
perks.description:
Final blows periodically apply modifications to this weapon, providing additional stats and benefits per modification:
  •  Chip: Faster handling and aim speed
  •  Barrel: Bonus range and stability
  •  Optics: Improved target acquisition
  •  Ammo: Shots detonate on impact

perks.description:
This weapon is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Increases stability
